notes: Five «ح»-separated routes. «كلهم عن عبيد الله» is written once after the four routes A to D, so Ubaydullah is in each of those four; the route E (Harun, Ibn Wahb, Usama) has its own names and meets the rest at «كلهم عن نافع، عن ابن عمر».
«بمثل حديث مالك عن نافع» names a different transmitter (Malik) for the same saying: a variant group, not a route of this saying (rule 4); it is the last group, with variant true.
The commas inside «وابن، رمح» and «عبيد، الله» are kept as written; the و conjunction is removed.
